messages:
Asha: Sunrise shift — quick sync.
Asha: Current incidents:
- regen-queue backlog in eu-west1 (~3k tasks, increased error rate for short prompts)
- kv-cache evictions spike on gpu-pool-b causing higher latency for embedding reads
Asha: Mitigations taken: throttled batch size to 8, routed low-priority jobs to spare-capacity pool, enabled cpu-quant fallback for low-priority lanes.
Ben: Thanks. Dashboards annotated? I'll add a canary route change. Which alert is firing for the regen queue?
Asha: PagerDuty: PD-regen (high latency). I silenced noisy non-critical alerts; kept PD active for paging teams.
Sam: @Asha can you paste curl to restart the queue worker? I'd like to do a graceful restart after warmup.
Asha: Sure:
```
# restart with warmup
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/v1/workers/restart \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"pool":"eu-west1-regen","grace_period":60,"warmup":true}'
```
Jia: I'll tail the regen consumer logs. If OOMs continue we should roll back yesterday's quant build — seeing larger mem footprint at batch size 12.
Ben: Can we toggle batch size globally? I can update autoscaler policy if needed.
Asha: Reduced default to 8 already. Ben, can you make that sticky for the next 2h? Set `autoscale.default_batch_size=8` and I'll revert once metrics stable.
ops-bot: Alert update: regen-queue-high-latency acknowledged; backlog decreasing.
Sam: Blockers: none immediate. I'll run regen smoke test (small corpus) in ~15m and report.
Ben: Monitoring kv-cache evictions; if eviction rate >5% for 10m I'll provision one extra node to gpu-pool-b.
Asha: Next steps: monitor until handoff, revert batch_size when stable, prepare rollback PR for quant build if OOMs exceed threshold. Ping thread for noisy alerts. Thanks team :thumbsup:
